items.html: Now, in this Galgalta of AA, there is within it only a single brain, which is called the Hochma of AA. And although this Hochma, this brain, contains within it the phase of three brains, as we will explain afterward, nevertheless all three of them are only the phase of Hochma itself. It thus follows that in this Rosh of AA there was only a single Galgalta, which is the Keter of AA, and within it a single brain, which is the Hochma of AA. But the Bina of AA could not remain there in the phase of the Rosh.
